artworks.title: Two Sheep, One Pissing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing two sheep in a natural setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear view of the sheep and the surrounding landscape. The horizon is implied without being explicitly shown. There are trees in the background, and the etching technique is used to create texture and depth, especially in the sheep's wool and the foliage. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and white. The sheep are depicted standing on grass, with detailed linework showing their coats and the ground. In the distance, there is a line of trees portrayed through varied etching strokes.

artworks.title: La Mare au diable
artworks.artist: Jean Jacques Outhwaite, after Charles-François Daubigny
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a scene in a dense forest with two figures sitting by a small campfire. The view is low to the ground, surrounded by thick trees and no visible sky. The branches arch overhead, framing the scene. The palette is primarily black, grey, and white, contrasting the darkness of the forest with the soft light of the fire. The texture of the foliage and shadows enhance the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Three Cherubs and Two Boys Each Raising One Arm on Clouds
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after Peeter van Avont
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows four cherubic figures seated or reclining on clouds. They appear unclothed, with small wings and youthful facial features. One cherub has shoulder-length wavy hair, while the others have short, curly hair. They look upwards with expressions of curiosity or engagement. Some are interacting with billowing fabric or ribbons. The background is a plain, textured space.

artworks.title: Woman Playing a Cittern
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting down with a stringed instrument. She is gazing slightly upward and to the right, with a gentle expression. Her hair is styled in curls and she wears a wide-brimmed hat with ribbons and lace. She is dressed in a detailed gown with floral patterns, accessorized with a necklace. The background is soft and lacks details, emphasizing the woman's elegant attire. The image appears to be a drawing or a print, created using fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Prince Eugene
artworks.artist: Antoine de Marcenay de Ghuy, after Jan Kupecy
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in armor. He has a serious expression, strong facial features, and tightly curled hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a suit of armor with engravings and a medal on his chest hanging from a ribbon. His arm rests on a cushion-like surface. The background is plain with a stippled effect. The portrait is framed with a decorative border, with an inscription reading "Le Prince Eugene" below, along with crossed palm fronds.

artworks.title: Colleur (Billposter)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [proof before letters]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person standing on a ladder engaged in painting or cleaning a wall. A man is positioned atop a ladder leaning against the wall on the left side of the image, reaching out with a brush or tool. Below him to the side, another individual stands observing or ready to assist, while on the ground near the ladder is a collection of tools or containers, possibly paint cans or buckets. On the right, a child, a dog, and an individual in a coat and top hat are depicted. The child appears to be gesturing with raised hands. The wall has posted bills or notices with visible text. Shadow lines from out-of-view bars stretch diagonally across the wall, creating a linear pattern that contrasts with the detailed line work of the figures. The drawing has a style reminiscent of classic etchings.

artworks.title: The Surgeon [reverse copy]
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century, after Lucas van Leyden
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 11.8 x 7.4 cm (4 5/8 x 2 15/16 in.) cut within platemark
mount: 13.5 x 9.2 cm (5 5/16 x 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. One person is kneeling and shown from head to toe. The other person is sitting on a chair and is mostly visible from the waist up. The kneeling person is positioned sideways, slightly turning towards the viewer. The seated individual appears to be focused on an activity over the head of the kneeling person. The seated person has a concerned expression with wide eyes and tense mouth. They have short, wavy hair and wear a long-sleeved tunic and fitted pants. The seated person has aged facial features, including drooping eyelids and deep lines. They wear a cap and a fur-lined garment. The background has a wooden or shaded interior with subtle hatching for shading. There is a chair and a bowl on a side table to the left.

artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite, with some corrections in white gouache
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated perspective, capturing a serene scene with two figures positioned close to us. One figure is leaning forward, engaged in an activity, while the other is seated against a tree with a contemplative posture. The composition leads the eye beyond the figures to a gentle slope that recedes into the landscape. The horizon is positioned in the distance, marked by a subtle division between the ground and the sky. On the horizon, the faint outline of more trees suggests continuity in the landscape. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, with a sketch-like quality. The color palette is predominantly sepia-toned, with varying shades of brown and beige creating depth and dimension. In the background, a few grazing animals add a pastoral touch to the scene, while the sky above remains soft and clear.

artworks.title: Balaklava
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor on paper laid down on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Florian Carr Fund

artworks.title: June
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Professor John Andrew Bernstein
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing among a group of trees, looking into a dense forest. The horizon is not distinctly visible. The scene is dominated by overlapping trees and foliage that extend upwards, suggesting a continuous canopy. The painting technique involves soft brushstrokes that blur the edges between the trees and the undergrowth, creating a dreamy atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by shades of green and blue, with occasional hints of brown and muted pastel tones, adding to the sense of depth and mystery in the wooded landscape. Light filters in from the distance, softly illuminating parts of the scene and enhancing the interplay between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Looking South into the Grand Cañon, Colorado River, Sheavwitz Crossing
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a steep canyon landscape with a large rock formation on the right side. The focus is on the rocky cliffs and the river running through them. The cliffs are jagged and layered, with a sepia-toned color palette enhancing the texture and shadows. Closest to the viewer is an overhanging rock, while in the distance, a river winds through the canyon.

artworks.title: Study for "The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1754: An Allegory of Waterworks"
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and brown ink with gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural façade. The structure is symmetrically arranged, with a central archway flanked by smaller entrances. Above the archway, there is an emblem adorned with symbols and figures. The façade includes columns, statues, balustrades, and domed roof elements at the top of each section. A wide staircase leads up to the entrance. The drawing features precise lines and a subtle wash to highlight the architectural details and spatial relationships.

artworks.title: Study for "The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1753: The Quarters of the Royal Militia"
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The drawing showcases a detailed, classical building with a round base and an octagonal upper section. It features fluted columns, flags, sculptural elements, and a clock on one side of the upper section. Flanking the building are additional architectural elements, including a tall column and statues on plinths. The drawing uses fine lines to delineate the contours and stonework of the architecture.

artworks.title: A Prison Interior with a Monumental Staircase
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with staircases and arched structures. The drawing depicts a complex stone interior with staircases, arches, and balustrades. The detailed rendering of the stonework and perspective create depth and scale. The lines and shading suggest architectural detail, capturing the structure's texture and form. The drawing is presented in a frame, highlighting its composition and craftsmanship.

artworks.title: A Monumental Vaulted Hall with a Smoking Altar
artworks.medium: pen and  ink with wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with columns and arches, leading the viewer's gaze towards a source of light at the end of the structure. The precise and linear brushstrokes highlight the architectural details. The color palette is sepia tones, giving the artwork a historic quality. Statues are positioned atop columns, and shadows and light play across the vaulted ceilings.

artworks.title: Half-Length Figure of a Woman Looking Sideward
artworks.artist: Bartholomäus Ignaz Weiss (in the manner of Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting the upper torso of a person in a slight recline, with their head turned downward and slightly to the left. The person's facial features include a somber expression with detailed, delicately rendered eyes, nose, and mouth. The individual has loosely wavy hair falling around the face, partially covered by a cloth headscarf or wrap tied at the back or atop their head. The clothing shown is a textured garment draped around the shoulders with loose, flowing lines. The person's arms are resting in front of the body. The background consists of textured lines implying vegetation or a neutral space. The etching has a border, and in the upper left corner, the text "CASTIONE" is visible.

artworks.title: Half-Length Figure Reading
artworks.artist: Bartholomäus Ignaz Weiss (in the manner of Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: This is an etching of a person shown from the waist up, positioned leaning slightly forward. The person's face is tilted downward, with closed eyes and serene facial features. They have curly hair that is tousled and extends around their face. The clothing appears to be a simple draped garment that covers the shoulders and chest. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of a textured surface with some plantlike details, suggesting foliage, adding depth to the scene. The overall presentation appears classical, consistent with pen and ink etching styles.

artworks.title: Tower at Tower Falls, Yellowstone
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: A tall, reddish-brown, spearhead-shaped rock formation slices up from a churning river into the sky in this vertical watercolor painting. To the right, a lower formation has a flattened top with what appear to be teeth-like boulders along the top. The river flows across the lower third of the painting and is painted with dark blues and greens, with white highlights suggesting fast-moving water. Several large, rounded boulders sit in the river and along its shore in the bottom center of the composition. To the right, the sandy bank slopes upward and is scattered with rounded stones and tufts of dry grass. In the background, faint outlines of tall cliffs and distant hills fade into a pale, misty sky. Light radiates from behind the central rock formation. The artist signed and dated the watercolor in the lower right corner, “TMoran 1872,” with the T and M conjoined to make a monogram.

artworks.title: Minerva Terrace, Yellowstone
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: This painting shows a view looking out over a vast landscape. Most of the painting is circular, with a small part of the bottom bleeding out of the circle towards us. The top third of the circle shows a mountain range with a large purple peak in the distance. In front of the mountain is a faint rainbow. A body of water flows from in front of the mountain to the bottom of the painting, weaving in between shorter white peaks. Towards the bottom, the water appears to flow into small, layered pools of various bright colors including yellow, orange, red, pink, blue, and teal. The sky is a light blue-gray color. The background of the painting outside of the circle is plain paper.

artworks.title: Hot Springs of Gardiner's River, Yellowstone
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Florian Carr Fund
artworks.description: This painting shows a colorful landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high under a cloudy blue-and-tan sky, and dark purple trees and hills are visible in the distance. The terrain closest to us is a series of terraced formations with water flowing over them, full of textured patterns and mineral deposits. The tiered layers of rock are painted in rusty red, vivid turquoise, and yellow ochre. White water flows down these rocks into small, layered pools that cover the landscape at the bottom of the painting. On the left, two people climb up the sides of the colorful rocks, so far away from us that they look tiny.

artworks.title: Aus Dem Tiergarten (From the Tiergarten)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with a bridge crossing over a waterway. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a wide view ahead. The skyline is depicted with a row of buildings and trees meeting the sky. The bridge arches gracefully over the river, supported by sturdy piers. The etching technique uses dark lines and cross-hatching for texture, particularly in the trees and water. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and gray, creating a moody atmosphere. The dark lines add texture to the trees and water, capturing the rustic landscape.

artworks.title: Tänzerinnen (Dancers)
artworks.medium: etching, softground etching, and roulette in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: This is a painting of three figures dancing in swirling dresses. The image portrays three figures caught in a moment of dance, each adorned in flowing dresses that seem to emulate the rhythm of their movements. Their poses suggest a dynamic energy, with one figure in a pose that makes the dress billow dramatically, adding to the sense of motion. The use of lines and shading gives the figures a sense of movement against a plain background, allowing the focus to remain on the interaction and grace of the dance.

artworks.title: Tom Mix II
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures riding horses through a rugged landscape. The composition features a group of riders adorned with broad-brimmed hats. The horses appear in dynamic poses, emphasizing movement. The background presents a mountainous terrain. The drawing employs bold, expressive lines to capture the energy and motion of the scene.

artworks.title: Tom Mix II
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures riding horses across a landscape. The image depicts a group of riders wearing large hats, each astride a horse that is in motion, situated against a backdrop of rolling hills or mountains. The style includes strong, bold lines creating a sense of dynamic movement and energy among the riders and horses. The landscape elements are simplified and stylized. The composition is tightly packed, emphasizing the collective action and unity of the figures, as they traverse the rugged terrain. The use of black and white enhances the overall mood, giving the drawing an intense and raw quality.
